description: This Java class provides a logging utility that simulates or wraps Android's native logging system. It defines log levels, manages a LogNode for chained logging, and offers various static methods for different log levels and message types.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class for logging that mimics the Android Log API, supports chaining LogNode instances, and provides static methods for different log levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head of the LogNode chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain where log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and throwable to the LogNode chain.
